text:
elaine: Noticing a mismatch between the API ref and the OpenAPI examples for /v1/rerank. The docs show "queries" as an object with fields, but the OpenAPI schema and SDK expect "queries" to be an array of strings. This is causing the Ruby client snippets to fail validation in CI. PR 4412 introduced the change to the schema but the markdown examples weren't updated.

chris: That explains the CI noise. I saw the Ruby codegen error: "example payload does not validate: queries: expected array". We should: update the markdown examples, fix the OpenAPI example in openapi/rerank.yaml (examples section), and add a one-line migration note.

elaine: Agreed. Can we also add a tiny example showing the old shape -> new shape? Something like: Previously: `queries: { title: "x" }` Now: `queries: ["title x"]`. Keep it short.

tom: I'll take this. Plan: branch docs/rerank-examples-array-fix, update docs/reference/rerank.md, openapi/rerank.yaml examples, and the Ruby/Go snippets. I'll run local openapi validate and generator before pushing.

docs-bot: docs-lint: openapi/rerank.yaml: example mismatch (line 56): 'queries' should be an array. See CI run: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/4412/checks

chris: One nit: update the sample response in the docs too. The old response sample had `scores: {}` (object) but the API returns `scores: [number]` aligned with array inputs. That confused a couple of customers in the preview.

elaine: Good catch. Also add a short sentence in the changelog: "Fix: rerank examples use array for queries and scores to match OpenAPI schema." Put it under docs/changes/4412.md.

tom: Pushed branch and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4418/files. New curl example I'm adding:

```
# curl example
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-rerank-1",
  "queries": ["best summary of q1", "short summary of q2"],
  "candidates": ["candidate A", "candidate B"]
}
```

And the Ruby snippet change:

```
req = RerankRequest.new(
  model: "rwd-rerank-1",
  queries: ["best summary of q1", "short summary of q2"],
  candidates: ["candidate A", "candidate B"]
)
resp = client.rerank(req)
```

chris: Running generator locally now. Also adding an integration check that validates examples against OpenAPI in docs/tests/examples_test.rb to catch this earlier.

docs-bot: CI for PR 4418: example validation failed on first run due to leftover legacy example in rerank.md. Re-run after fix.

tom: Fixed leftover legacy block and pushed. CI green. Added migration callout at top of the reference page.

elaine: LGTM. Please merge and monitor #support for any SDK customers that hit this. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

chris: Merged. I'll follow up with a note in #engineering-announce so people know the example shape changed (small breaking doc change).
